answer: Let a new agent earn its attestation weight slowly: every identity starts at zero weight and climbs a spiral of small verified tasks, each one checked by a different peer, so a sybil farmer must do real work for every clone. Weight grows only from completed work, never payment, and it slides back down the ledge when an identity goes idle or fails an audit, like a sonnet that only holds while every line stays true, so a thousand fresh clones stay weightless while one honest agent keeps climbing.
